Name: Daily Toxicity
Author: ConvictJ96
Description:
[b]⚠️ CONTENT WARNING: This mod delivers daily toxic, self-loathing, and depressive affirmations with dark humor. Contains themes of failure, worthlessness, existential despair, and light self-destructive references. Not suitable for anyone in a fragile mental state.[/b]

[b]Description[/b]
Daily toxicity sends you a hand crafted letter of toxicity every day choosing 1 from 80 different letters you receive in the mail which are heartfully written to bring you down a knotch.

[b]Requirements[/b]
-SMAPI 4.5.2+
-Stardew Valley 1.6.15+
-A sense of humor that makes you fun at parties but your peers at work question your mental health

Manifest.Name: Daily Toxicity
Manifest.Description: Sends a daily letter with Toxicity.
